compatibility_note: Bundle refresh r138: MagicExpansion 1.1.15 makes the SF Timings Machine request shared detailed Slimefun profiler samples automatically, so it no longer depends on an operator running /sf tick top. Missing/stale samples are explicit and labels now identify Slimefun total versus this chunk. All 44 other addon JARs, the Slimefun 4.1.74 core and the resource pack remain unchanged. This does not change item IDs, recipes, stored machine data, Black Market records or fishing behavior.
